alt: Aerial photo of Switzerland's World Cup training pitch in San Diego with a bold red overlay on the canyon hillside behind it reading 'SNAKE AREA' in large white text
story: Switzerland's FIFA-approved 2026 World Cup training base at San Diego Jewish Academy required the Swiss Football Association to mark a red 'SNAKE AREA' on their official facility map — because four species of venomous rattlesnakes inhabit the California canyon behind the pitch.
why_funny: FIFA planned a World Cup across North America without checking whether 'no venomous wildlife on the training pitch' was a reasonable expectation, forcing Switzerland to publish an official snake-exclusion zone as part of their training-camp layout.
